raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search results by conflating the Overseas BBC Sports Personality of the Year award with the main SPOTY award, incorrectly concluding that Muhammad Ali (Overseas winner, 3 times) held the record for the main award. This led the process toward identifying the wrong person’s brother instead of the correct record holder (Andy Murray).
